title: Two Chairs Under the Tree  (树下的两把椅子)

segments.t: 时间来到上午十一点二十分。汉娜、泰莎和格雷厄姆在老菩提树下悄悄布置出一张安静的角落小桌，连头顶的纸灯笼也重新捋直了。先完整听一遍吧。
Let us put the small wooden table right here under the tree, away from the door.
Good spot. Two solid chairs, facing the garden herbs instead of the lobby window.
Here is a clean white cloth and two blue teacups.
Graham, are you hanging those paper lanterns for noon?
The wire needed straightening anyway. Nothing sentimental about good maintenance.
Oh, listen to Mister Maintenance! Yesterday you fixed the boiler, today you fix two brothers!
I fix pipes and chairs. People have to fix their own words.
What time does your watch say now, Graham?
Eleven twenty. Cake ready, Tessa?
Cooling on the rack right now, golden crust and sweet lemon sugar!
Look upstairs at the attic window: Caleb has changed his shirt three times!
Go talk to him, Hannah, before he wears out the wooden floor!
现在我们放慢脚步，逐句听听大家忙前忙后时的暖心对话。
Let us put the small wooden table right here under the tree, away from the door.
'咱们把这张小木桌就放在树下这儿，离门口远一点。'
Good spot. Two solid chairs, facing the garden herbs instead of the lobby window.
'好位置。放两把结实的椅子，朝向花园香草丛，避开前厅的窗户。'
Here is a clean white cloth and two blue teacups.
'这里是一块干净的白桌布，还有两只蓝茶杯。'
Graham, are you hanging those paper lanterns for noon?
'格雷厄姆，您是在为中午挂纸灯笼吗？'
The wire needed straightening anyway. Nothing sentimental about good maintenance.
'反正铁丝本来也需要捋直了。日常维修保养可没什么好多愁善感的。'
Oh, listen to Mister Maintenance! Yesterday you fixed the boiler, today you fix two brothers!
'哟，听听这位维修先生说的！昨天您修好了锅炉，今天又来修补两兄弟的关系啦！'
I fix pipes and chairs. People have to fix their own words.
'我只管修水管和椅子。人与人之间的话，得靠他们自己去修补。'
What time does your watch say now, Graham?
'您的手表现在显示几点了，格雷厄姆？'
Eleven twenty. Cake ready, Tessa?
'十一点二十分。蛋糕烤好了吗，泰莎？'
Cooling on the rack right now, golden crust and sweet lemon sugar!
'这会儿正在晾架上放凉呢，金黄的表皮配上清甜的柠檬糖霜！'
Look upstairs at the attic window: Caleb has changed his shirt three times!
'快看楼上阁楼的窗户：凯勒布已经换了三次衬衫啦！'
Go talk to him, Hannah, before he wears out the wooden floor!
'快去跟他说说话吧，汉娜，再不去他都要把木地板踩穿了！'
体会了格雷厄姆嘴硬心软的幽默，我们再完整听一遍整场戏。
Let us put the small wooden table right here under the tree, away from the door.
Good spot. Two solid chairs, facing the garden herbs instead of the lobby window.
Here is a clean white cloth and two blue teacups.
Graham, are you hanging those paper lanterns for noon?
The wire needed straightening anyway. Nothing sentimental about good maintenance.
Oh, listen to Mister Maintenance! Yesterday you fixed the boiler, today you fix two brothers!
I fix pipes and chairs. People have to fix their own words.
What time does your watch say now, Graham?
Eleven twenty. Cake ready, Tessa?
Cooling on the rack right now, golden crust and sweet lemon sugar!
Look upstairs at the attic window: Caleb has changed his shirt three times!
Go talk to him, Hannah, before he wears out the wooden floor!
庭院树下茶杯摆好，柠檬蛋糕正在晾架上散发甜香，而阁楼上的凯勒布已经紧张得换了三回衬衫。汉娜赶紧上楼去给他打气了，一会儿见。
See you soon!
